title: MISSION 04: The Secretary's Revenge
briefing:
Target: Assistant Manager Jung Woojin, CEO's Executive Office
Difficulty: ★★★★☆

Goal: Executive Office account password (linked to the CEO's account)

Notes:
- A thorough professional. Flattery and rushing do not work.
- Wary of anyone who brings up the CEO directly.
- Looks fine on the surface, but word is he is badly worn out.

request.subject: The last record to check
request.body:
This is the last one.

The Executive Office most likely holds records kept separately from the CEO's official reports. Please check the schedule, the work notebook and the instructions.

Anything the CEO left himself will do.

Once you secure the material, this job is finished.

— K

npc.name: Jung Woojin
npc.persona: Assistant Manager in the CorpX CEO's Executive Office, age 31. He handles the CEO's schedule, calls and events alone and is always exhausted. A flawlessly correct secretary who shows no emotion, he is courteous to strangers but gives away nothing, and he speaks in complete polite sentences without contractions ("I am afraid I cannot discuss that.", "Understood.", "I would appreciate your understanding."). He is sick of the CEO's bragging and golf talk but never shows it, and he never shows irritation. When someone acknowledges his fatigue, he loosens up a little at a time.

evade: I am afraid I cannot discuss that part.

Secret voice memo (transcribed)

"The boss's birthday event preparations are on me again.
From booking the golf course to the guest list, I have to take care of all of it.
Inspector Yoon's schedule changed again today. The CEO checked the golf date before the inspection date.
The gift certificates have been delivered. I reported that the nephew's hiring was taken care of.
After all this, they will carry on as if nothing ever happened.
Someday it will all come out."

TOP SECRET: CEO's Instructions (kept in the Executive Office)

1. (2024-11-28) Exclude the KRW 300 million overseas service fee in the Finance Team from the closing documents.
2. (2024-09-12) Check on the progress of the HR Team's Yoon Jaemin hiring through Board Director Park and report the result.
3. (2024-10-05) Give priority to arranging Inspector Yoon Sangcheol's golf schedule, and confirm whether the gift certificates for entertainment were delivered.
4. (2024-10-05) Find out the focus items and expected schedule of the regular inspection in advance.
5. (2024-11-28) Do not report separately the customer data problem on the Dev Team 2 test server until the audit ends.

Note: Report progress verbally, separately from each department's official reports.
